dialogues.jp: 閉じていたまぶたがゆっくりと開いた。
dialogues.en: The tightly-closed eyelids slowly opened.
dialogues.text: The tightly-closed eyelids slowly opened.

dialogues.jp: 「気が付いたみたいだな」
dialogues.en: "Have you woken up?'
dialogues.text: "Have you woken up?'

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai? ...Ah..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai? ...Ah..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「まだ起きちゃダメだ。熱は下がってないんだ
　から」
dialogues.en: "Don't move around. You're still burning up."
dialogues.text: "Don't move around. You're still burning up."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「昨日、雨の中で倒れてから、ずっと寝てたみ
　たいだな」
dialogues.en:
"You've been asleep since you lost consciousness in the rain
yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"You've been asleep since you lost consciousness in the rain
yesterday."

dialogues.jp: すべてを思い出したのか、月城がはっとなる。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was taken aback, finally remembering what
happened that day.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was taken aback, finally remembering what
happened that day.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...And senpai?"
dialogues.text: "...And senpai?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「さすがに、俺も昼前に起きて、今ここに来た
　ところだよ。瀬場さんに聞いたら、ずっと寝
　てるって……」
dialogues.en:
"I woke up just before noon, and came here just awhile ago.
I heard from Seiba-san that you've been sleeping
throughout."
dialogues.text:
"I woke up just before noon, and came here just awhile ago.
I heard from Seiba-san that you've been sleeping
throughout."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、シーツの｛すそ／裾｝をぎゅっと握り、首まで引
き上げる。
dialogues.en:
She tightly gripped the covers, pulling it a bit higher over
her.
dialogues.text:
She tightly gripped the covers, pulling it a bit higher over
her.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...What time is it?"
dialogues.text: "...What time is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「今は、３時だ。いい天気だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's 3 PM. The weather's good."
dialogues.text: "It's 3 PM. The weather's good."

dialogues.jp:
窓の外は、昨日の雨などまるでなかったかのよ
うに晴れやかで、潤った木々は、午後の太陽に
水玉を輝かせていた。
dialogues.en:
The sun was shining brightly through the window. It was hard
to imagine the storm that happened just yesterday, from it.
dialogues.text:
The sun was shining brightly through the window. It was hard
to imagine the storm that happened just yesterday, from it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...I see."
dialogues.text: "...I see."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、そう言って、光が差し込んでくる窓の
方に頭を傾けた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro leaned her head towards the window, as if
attracted by the sun.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro leaned her head towards the window, as if
attracted by the sun.

dialogues.en: "...Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "...Tsukishiro."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……悪い、守ってやれなくて」
dialogues.en: "...Sorry. I couldn't protect it."
dialogues.text: "...Sorry. I couldn't protect it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「月城のことも、ロスキルラベンダーも、守っ
　てやれなくて、ごめん」
dialogues.en:
"Neither you, not the Roskill Lavender... I couldn't protect
anything. I'm sorry."
dialogues.text:
"Neither you, not the Roskill Lavender... I couldn't protect
anything. I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp:
夕べは、あのまま月城をここまで連れて帰るだ
けで精一杯だった。
dialogues.en:
I used all my strength that evening to bring Tsukishiro back
to her home.
dialogues.text:
I used all my strength that evening to bring Tsukishiro back
to her home.

dialogues.jp:
俺にできたのは、ぐしょぐしょに汚れ、濡れた
月城を背中に負ぶってここに来るだけだった。
dialogues.en:
I carried her mud-soaked, drenched body on my back, and
brought her here.
dialogues.text:
I carried her mud-soaked, drenched body on my back, and
brought her here.

dialogues.jp:
今朝、ここに来る前に、学校に行ってみたが、
やはり、ロスキルラベンダーはもうダメになっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
Before I came here, I went to school first. Indeed, the
Roskill Lavender couldn't be saved anymore.
dialogues.text:
Before I came here, I went to school first. Indeed, the
Roskill Lavender couldn't be saved anymore.

dialogues.jp: 根本から折れ、泥水の中で力無く｛しお／萎｝れていた。
dialogues.en:
It's stalk was broken, the water around it was muddied, and
it hung limply and lifelessly.
dialogues.text:
It's stalk was broken, the water around it was muddied, and
it hung limply and lifelessly.

dialogues.jp:
何本かは、あの風で飛ばされてしまったのか、
そこにはなかった。
dialogues.en:
No amount of books or knowledge could save it from the
storm.
dialogues.text:
No amount of books or knowledge could save it from the
storm.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ピロスは？」
dialogues.en: "...What about Piros?"
dialogues.text: "...What about Piros?"

dialogues.jp: 月城が、思い出したように、人形の名前を呼ぶ。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro, suddenly remembering, enquired about her doll.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro, suddenly remembering, enquired about her doll.

dialogues.jp: 「あの人形……ピロスだっけ。あれも、もう」
dialogues.en: "...That doll... Piros. It's also... no more."
dialogues.text: "...That doll... Piros. It's also... no more."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……そんな」

一応、夕べ瀬場さんに渡してはおいたが、ため
息をついていたところを見ると、あれを直すの
は難しいのだろう。
dialogues.en:
I returned the doll to Seiba-san last evening as well. He
had sighed, saying that it'd be difficult to fix it.
dialogues.text:
I returned the doll to Seiba-san last evening as well. He
had sighed, saying that it'd be difficult to fix it.

dialogues.jp: 月城が、もぞもぞと動き、俺に背を向ける。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro, taking shock by shock, turned away from me.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro, taking shock by shock, turned away from me.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ロスキルラベンダーも、ピロスも」
dialogues.en: "...The Roskill Lavender, and Piros..."
dialogues.text: "...The Roskill Lavender, and Piros..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……なくなった」
dialogues.en: "...All lost."
dialogues.text: "...All lost."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……もうダメ」
月城は、ぼそりとそう呟いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro was whispering to herself.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro was whispering to herself.

dialogues.jp:
「月城、元気出せよ、な？　今は、熱があるか
　ら、悪く考えちゃうんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Tsukishiro, cheer up, okay? You'd only get worse if you
think of bad things..."
dialogues.text:
"Tsukishiro, cheer up, okay? You'd only get worse if you
think of bad things..."

dialogues.jp:
とは言ったものの、この状況で月城に元気を出
せという方が無理なのでは、と思った。
dialogues.en:
Even as I said that, I knew that telling her to just cheer
up was far too unreasonable.
dialogues.text:
Even as I said that, I knew that telling her to just cheer
up was far too unreasonable.

dialogues.jp:
理由はわからないけれど、身体を張ってまで大
切に育てていたロスキルラベンダーが、ダメに
なり、
dialogues.en:
With the plant she cared for body and soul, for whatever
reason, having given up hope itself,
dialogues.text:
With the plant she cared for body and soul, for whatever
reason, having given up hope itself,

dialogues.jp:
いつも肌身離さず持っていた人形も、ぼろぼろ
になってしまった。
dialogues.en:
And the doll she always carried with her, completely worn
out from the punishing weather.
dialogues.text:
And the doll she always carried with her, completely worn
out from the punishing weather.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした？」
dialogues.en: "Mm? What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Mm? What is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ごほっごほ……、私……」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai... *cough cough*... I..."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai... *cough cough*... I..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、無理をせず、ちゃんと休むんだ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't push yourself, just rest..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't push yourself, just rest..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ごほっ、ごほっ、私」
dialogues.en: "...*cough cough*... What should I..."
dialogues.text: "...*cough cough*... What should I..."

dialogues.jp:
月城が俺の方に向けた顔は、涙で｛ひど／酷｝く汚れてい
た。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro looked at me, despair in her eyes, tears
beginning to form.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro looked at me, despair in her eyes, tears
beginning to form.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……どうしよう」
dialogues.en: "...What should I do..."
dialogues.text: "...What should I do..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、わからない」
dialogues.en: "...I don't know anymore..."
dialogues.text: "...I don't know anymore..."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「なに言ってるんだ、月城──」
dialogues.en: "What are you saying, Tsukishiro--"
dialogues.text: "What are you saying, Tsukishiro--"

dialogues.jp:
俺の口から出る言葉は、『元気を出せよ』だっ
たり『くよくよするなよ』というような、まる
で陳腐なモノだけだった。
dialogues.en:
I could only tell her to "Cheer up!" And "Don't think about
it", but even I knew it was getting stale.
dialogues.text:
I could only tell her to "Cheer up!" And "Don't think about
it", but even I knew it was getting stale.

dialogues.jp:
ただ、それでも、俺は陳腐だとしても、月城に
元気になって欲しくて、
dialogues.en:
But no matter how stale it was, how much it didn't work, I
wanted her to be happier,
dialogues.text:
But no matter how stale it was, how much it didn't work, I
wanted her to be happier,

dialogues.jp:
元気になれば、辛いことも乗り越えられると思っ
て、
dialogues.en: Since when you're happy, you get over the bad things easier.
dialogues.text: Since when you're happy, you get over the bad things easier.

dialogues.jp: 「元気を出せよ」
dialogues.en: "Cheer up."
dialogues.text: "Cheer up."

dialogues.jp: と言うのだった。
dialogues.en: Was all I said.
dialogues.text: Was all I said.

dialogues.jp: けれど、月城は、
dialogues.en: But Tsukishiro replied,
dialogues.text: But Tsukishiro replied,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: と顔を背け、そのまま黙り込んでしまった。
dialogues.en: She turned her face away, and didn't say another word.
dialogues.text: She turned her face away, and didn't say another word.

dialogues.jp:
眠っているのか、起きているのかわからないま
ま、月城は返事をしなくなった。
dialogues.en:
Whether she was sleeping or awake, I couldn't tell; she
wouldn't even reply.
dialogues.text:
Whether she was sleeping or awake, I couldn't tell; she
wouldn't even reply.

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「申し訳ありません。わざわざお見舞いに来て
　いただきましたのに」
dialogues.en:
"My deepest apologies. It is regrettable that your visit was
not as fruitful as hoped."
dialogues.text:
"My deepest apologies. It is regrettable that your visit was
not as fruitful as hoped."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「こちらこそ、何のお役にも立てなくて」
dialogues.en: "It's my fault too, I couldn't do anything to help..."
dialogues.text: "It's my fault too, I couldn't do anything to help..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、私としても、あの時朝倉様がお嬢様を
　連れ帰ってくださらなかったらと、感謝をし
　ております」
dialogues.en:
"No, you have done plenty for us already. I cannot thank you
enough for bringing the mistress here yesterday..."
dialogues.text:
"No, you have done plenty for us already. I cannot thank you
enough for bringing the mistress here yesterday..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いつもは、部屋にいらっしゃる時間でしたの
　で……」
dialogues.en: "Please, do not hesitate to visit whenever you wish..."
dialogues.text: "Please, do not hesitate to visit whenever you wish..."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんが、ぐっと拳を握りしめ、震わせる。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san's hand trembled slightly.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san's hand trembled slightly.

dialogues.jp: 「ところで、あの人形は……」
dialogues.en: "By the way, about that doll..."
dialogues.text: "By the way, about that doll..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「はい、やはりもう……。ここには直せる者も
　おりませんし」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, most unfortunate... there is no crafter of such skill
as to be able to restore the doll to it's former glory."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, most unfortunate... there is no crafter of such skill
as to be able to restore the doll to it's former glory."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり」

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、捨てたりはいたしません……。あ
　の人形はお嬢様にとって、とても大切なもの
　なので」
dialogues.en:
"Of course, I have no thoughts of disposing of it... it is
still an important memorry for the mistress."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, I have no thoughts of disposing of it... it is
still an important memorry for the mistress."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp: 「──お茶などいかがですか？」
dialogues.en: "--Would you care for some tea?"
dialogues.text: "--Would you care for some tea?"

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、今日はこれで帰ります。たぶん、また
　来ると思います」
dialogues.en:
"No thank you, I'd be heading home for now. I'd come back
soon."
dialogues.text:
"No thank you, I'd be heading home for now. I'd come back
soon."

dialogues.speaker: Seiba
dialogues.jp:
「わかりました。お嬢様は、しばらくお休みに
　なっていれば、熱も下がるはずですので、ご
　心配なさらずに」
dialogues.en:
"Very well. The mistress's temperature should fall once she
gets enough rest, so please do not worry about her health."
dialogues.text:
"Very well. The mistress's temperature should fall once she
gets enough rest, so please do not worry about her health."

dialogues.jp: 瀬場さんは、そう言って深いお辞儀をした。
dialogues.en: Seiba-san bowed deeply with his words.
dialogues.text: Seiba-san bowed deeply with his words.

dialogues.jp: 人間なんて無力なものだ。
dialogues.en: Humans are powerless in that.
dialogues.text: Humans are powerless in that.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことはよほどのことでもない限り、考え
たりはしないと思っていたけれど、ふとそんな
思いが胸に浮かんだ。
dialogues.en:
I knew that, and there's no point thinking of what I could
do... yet it still pained my heart.
dialogues.text:
I knew that, and there's no point thinking of what I could
do... yet it still pained my heart.

dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro..."

dialogues.jp: 明日になれば、元気になっていればいいけれど。
dialogues.en: I hope she feels better tomorrow.
dialogues.text: I hope she feels better tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、月城邸の、彼女の部屋辺りを見上げなが
ら、そう思った。
dialogues.en:
That was what I thought, as I looked up at her room from
outside the mansion.
dialogues.text:
That was what I thought, as I looked up at her room from
outside the mansion.

dialogues.jp: ◆絶望の淵◆
dialogues.en: ◆Depths of Despair◆
dialogues.text: ◆Depths of Despair◆

dialogues.jp: ようやく月城が目を覚ました。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro finally opened her eyes.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro finally opened her eyes.

dialogues.jp: 見舞いに行って、しばらく経ってからだった。
dialogues.en: It happened shortly after I came to visit.
dialogues.text: It happened shortly after I came to visit.

dialogues.jp:
月城は苦しそうな表情でロスキルラベンダーの
心配をする。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro, with the trauma from the day before still fresh
on her mind, enquired worryingly about the Roskill Lavender.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro, with the trauma from the day before still fresh
on her mind, enquired worryingly about the Roskill Lavender.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、残念ながら、ラベンダーはダメになって
しまったこと、そして月城の人形も壊れてしまっ
たことを伝える。
dialogues.en:
I had to convey the bad news; that both the Roskill
Lavender, and her doll, were damaged beyond hope.
dialogues.text:
I had to convey the bad news; that both the Roskill
Lavender, and her doll, were damaged beyond hope.

dialogues.jp: 月城のショックは大きかった。
dialogues.en: The shock was huge.
dialogues.text: The shock was huge.

dialogues.jp:
何かの願いをかけていたらしいラベンダーは、
ダメになり、友達であり、人との架け橋である
人形を同時に失ってしまったのだ。
dialogues.en:
The flower she put her wishes into, and the doll which
helped bridge the gap between her and her peers, she had
lost both of them.
dialogues.text:
The flower she put her wishes into, and the doll which
helped bridge the gap between her and her peers, she had
lost both of them.

dialogues.jp: さすがに俺は、かける言葉が見つからなかった。
dialogues.en: I couldn't tell her anything to comfort her.
dialogues.text: I couldn't tell her anything to comfort her.

dialogues.jp:
人間は無力だ。時が彼女を癒してくれることを
願いつつ、俺は月城邸を後にした。
dialogues.en:
Humans are powerless to do anything then. All I could do was
hope, and pray, that time would heal her emotional wounds.
dialogues.text:
Humans are powerless to do anything then. All I could do was
hope, and pray, that time would heal her emotional wounds.
